scripts.qa:reset: docker compose -f docker-compose.qa.yml down --volumes --remove-orphans && docker compose -f docker-compose.qa.yml up -d --build
scripts.qa:restart: docker compose -f docker-compose.qa.yml restart && npm run qa:verify
scripts.qa:certify: npm run qa:reset && npm run qa:verify && npm run qa:restart && npm run qa:dependency-failure
